compounds.name: Protocatechuic Acid
compounds.hint_role: 3,4-Dihydroxybenzoate funneling hub of the bacterial beta-ketoadipate pathway (PcaHG substrate).

compounds.name: Pyocyanin

compounds.name: Pyrrolnitrin

compounds.name: Pyruvic acid

compounds.name: Quinine

compounds.name: Serotonin
